notes: QA Dashboard v1.4 — INVOICE COMPLIANCE (Signed / Paid) added on top of v1.3. Data: optional per-job fields g (1 signed / 0 unsigned) and ps (Paid Status text) joined from the ServiceTitan 'Invoice Compliance' export by Invoice # == Job # (job invoice only; 9-digit adjustment invoices never match), invoices with Subtotal < $130 ignored; QC_DATA.inv = {file,min,rows,matched} or null when the report is missing (soft degrade: Signed/Paid UI hidden + amber note). UI: card 'Invoice' chip row — Signed % graded vs 100% target (green 100 / amber >=80 / red), Paid % informational; every detail table gets Signed (check/x/'—') and Paid (Paid/Overdue/'—') columns; per-panel exception filter All / Unsigned / Overdue (composes with bucket bar + search). Footer documents the source. v1.3 base unchanged: view toggle Install/Service/All (Install default), Install view Full Systems / Partials / Warranty with two stacked panels, Service view Demand / Maintenance / Callback, All view classic four cards, ServiceTitan click-through, header-name column resolution, sections by Job Class, Install headline = Full Systems only. Published as PLAINTEXT (no login).
